options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: auth
options.description: Log authentication events to the remote syslog server(s).

options.name: dhcp
options.description: Log DHCP events to the remote syslog server(s).

options.name: disablelocallogging
options.description: Disable writing log entries to the local disk. WARNING: This will also disable Login Protection!

options.name: dpinger
options.description: Log gateway monitoring events to the remote syslog server(s).

options.name: enableremotelogging
options.description: Enable remote logging.

options.name: filter
options.description: Log filter events to the remote syslog server(s).

options.name: filterdescriptions
options.description: Display filter descriptions in the log entries Use `0` to not load descriptions, `1` to display descriptions in their own column, or `2` to display the description in a second row.

options.name: format
options.description: The format of the log entries.

options.name: hostapd
options.description: Log wireless authentication events to the remote syslog server(s).

options.name: ipprotocol
options.description: The IP protocol to use for remote logging.

options.name: logall
options.description: Log everything to the remote syslog server(s).

options.name: logcompressiontype
options.description: The type of compression to use for log files.

options.name: logconfigchanges
options.description: Log changes made to the pfSense configuration.

options.name: logfilesize
options.description: The maximum size of the log file in kilobytes.

options.name: nentries
options.description: The number of log entries to display in the UI.

options.name: nologbogons
options.description: Log packets blocked by Block Bogon Networks rules.

options.name: nologdefaultblock
options.description: Do not log packets that are blocked by the implicit default block rule.

options.name: nologdefaultpass
options.description: Do not log packets that are allowed by the implicit default pass rule.

options.name: nolognginx
options.description: Do not Log errors from the web server process.

options.name: nologprivatenets
options.description: Log packets blocked by Block Private Networks rules.

options.name: ntpd
options.description: Log NTP events to the remote syslog server(s).

options.name: portalauth
options.description: Log captive portal authentication events to the remote syslog server(s).

options.name: ppp
options.description: Log PPP events to the remote syslog server(s).

options.name: rawfilter
options.description: Display logs in the UI as they are generated by the packet filter, without any formatting.

options.name: remoteserver
options.description: The first remote syslog server to send log entries to.

options.name: remoteserver2
options.description: The second remote syslog server to send log entries to.

options.name: remoteserver3
options.description: The third remote syslog server to send log entries to.

options.name: resolver
options.description: Log DNS resolver events to the remote syslog server(s).

options.name: reverseorder
options.description: Reverse the order of log entries.

options.name: rotatecount
options.description: The number of log file rotations to keep.

options.name: routing
options.description: Log routing events to the remote syslog server(s).

options.name: sourceip
options.description: The interface to use as the source IP address for remote logging.

options.name: system
options.description: Log system events to the remote syslog server(s).

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.

options.name: vpn
options.description: Log VPN events to the remote syslog server(s).
